source.title: A Lesson in Literacy
source.objective:
ProgressYour progress in the arcane arts has been exemplary, <name>. I think you are ready to author a spellbook of your own.

Let's see... a quill from the Owlbeasts of the Hinterlands, and ink derived from silithid resin... yes, that will do. And for the pages, the finest Farraki Papyrus!
source.completion: Your spellbook is ready, <name>. May you fill its pages with arcane secrets to rival the ancient libraries of Elun'dris and Zuldazar.
